starting_setup: Two open opaque bins with exterior cues
Place bins in marked feasible stations
Verify local and reveal views before recording

families.F1: Place the cube in the selected bin, then relocate the bin while the second agent records its exterior.
families.F2: Record an attempted placement where the cube visibly remains on the surface. Relocate the same candidate bin.
families.F3: Record a successful placement and a later supervised removal or repacking witnessed by only one agent.
families.F4: Use two similar bins. Record partial exterior views during a crossing or occlusion.
families.F5: Place the small bin into one reachable larger bin. Record the rearrangement only if clearances have passed preflight.
families.F6: Withhold the decisive acquisition window from all agents. Keep separate evaluator truth.

starting_setup: One target cube inside the verified reach envelope
One open opaque bin with an unobstructed approach
Raw wrist and local station RGB
Verify ordered state and command targets

families.SO101-placement: Demonstrate cube pickup, stable carry, placement, release and empty withdrawal at the validated station.
